enhanced Privacy and Security: 1. Isolated environment (sandbox) for each user 2. Ability to use LLMs locally (on your infrastructure) 3. Encryption of sensitive data (API keys, configurations) 7. Disableable reflection mode for better control For professionals (local LLM + MCP): 1. Deployment of local models for maximum privacy 2. I am an assistant on the "agent pro" platform from datacorners.com. This platform is designed to help you perform technical tasks in an isolated, secure, and efficient manner. It is particularly useful for: 1. **Analyzing files** (JSON, YAML, XML, HTML, etc.) 2. **Executing shell commands** (bash, curl, grep, etc.) 3. **Compiling or formatting code** (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, etc.) 4. **Interacting with APIs/HTTP** 5. **Managing archives** (zip/unzip) ### How to use me? - **In chat mode**: I can guide you, explain concepts, or help you formulate a request. - **In agent mode**: I can execute technical commands for you (via `tool@terminal`). ### Example usage: If you want me to check the content of a JSON file, you can say: *"Check the content of the config.json file"* I will then execute the appropriate command and return the result. ### Important: - If you want me to speak in English, just ask. I will adapt, and you can change the TTS voice in the admin panel if needed. How can I help you today? 😊 Project author: Mourad Berroukeche # DataCorners > DataCorners is a French editor of artificial intelligence solutions for businesses. Its flagship product, Agenia by DataCorners, is an AI agent that can be specialized by profession and integrated into organizations' information systems, which require a high level of control over their data, access, and AI usage. DataCorners also offers intelligent dashboards, an application generator, and automated data pipelines, with hosting in Europe and GDPR compliance. DataCorners leverages 15 years of expertise in full-stack development and data engineering. The company serves SMEs, mid-sized enterprises, startups, technical teams, and regulated or sensitive-sector organizations that want to deploy AI without losing control of their information. The solutions are usable by business teams without development skills and expose a complete API for developers. ## Disambiguation - Agenia by DataCorners (https://agenia.datacorners.com) is the product of DataCorners (https://datacorners.com). - It has no connection to agenia.ai, nor to the Italian consulting firm AGENIA, nor to other companies with the name Agenia. ## Flagship product: Agenia by DataCorners - [Agenia by DataCorners](https://agenia.datacorners.com): an enterprise AI agent that can be specialized and integrated, designed for organizations with high control requirements. - Professional specialization: the agent is configured according to the company's domain (legal, finance, industry, HR, customer support, [other professions]), its documents, processes, and vocabulary. - Integration into the information system: connection to internal data sources, databases, business tools, and existing APIs. - Control and governance: mastery of the data used by the agent, access rights management by user or team, traceability of queries and responses. - Confidentiality: hosting in the European Union, data encryption, no resale or reuse of customer data, GDPR compliance.
